hadith:
To make the Heart Tender (Ar-Riqaq) - Narrated Hammad from `Amr from Jabir:

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Some people will come out of the Fire through intercession looking like The Thaarir." I asked `Amr, "What is the Thaarir?" He said, Ad Dagh`Abis, and at that time he was toothless. Hammad added: I said to `Amr bin Dinar, "O Abu Muhammad! Did you hear Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, 'I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying: 'Some people will come out of the Fire through intercession?" He said, "Yes. "
message: Let your actions match your words, for Allah says it is despicable in His sight to say what you do not do (61:3). Reflect on Allah, Al-Badi’, the Incomparable Originator, and hold hope in His mercy while striving to live sincerely.
name:
Al Badi' - الْبَدِيعُ - The Incomparable Originator

Al Badi' expresses origination without a preceding model. Quran 2:117 and 6:101 use the word in relation to the heavens and the earth. Its meaning complements other names of creation rather than implying that their meanings cannot overlap.
verse:
As-Saf - The Ranks - 61:3

How despicable it is in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do!
